greet.speaker: Fairy
greet.text: A traveler... it has been so long since anyone found this pool.

choices.label: I'm looking for a way into the mountains.

who-are-you.speaker: Fairy
who-are-you.text: I am the spirit of this spring. I have watched over it since before your grandfather's grandfather.

who-are-you-2.speaker: Fairy
who-are-you-2.text: Few travelers pass this way anymore. Tell me, why have you come?

choices.label: I'm looking for a way into the mountains.

fairy-amused.speaker: Fairy
fairy-amused.text: A wanderer's heart. I respect that. But should you ever need my help, you know where to find me.

ask-mountains.speaker: Link
ask-mountains.text: I'm trying to find a path through the mountains, but the old bridge is broken.

fairy-considers.speaker: Fairy
fairy-considers.text: The bridge fell an age ago. But there is another way, if you're willing to earn it.

choices.label: I'm willing. What do you need?
Never mind, I'll find another way.

quest-offer.speaker: Fairy
quest-offer.text: Bring me three silver scales from the river pike, and I will raise a bridge of light across the chasm.

choices.label: That sounds like too much trouble.

quest-accepted.speaker: Fairy
quest-accepted.text: Good. Return to me when you have them, and do not tarry — the pike grow bolder after dusk.

quest-turn-in.speaker: Fairy
quest-turn-in.text: Three scales, gleaming and true. You have more than earned your passage, traveler.

bridge-rises.speaker: Narrator
bridge-rises.text: The water churns and a bridge of pale light arcs across the chasm, humming softly in the dark.

quest-declined.speaker: Fairy
quest-declined.text: As you wish. The offer will keep, should you change your mind.

leave-early.speaker: Link
leave-early.text: Sorry to intrude. I'll leave you in peace.
